title: monanthotaxis littoralis
intro: Monanthotaxis littoralis, commonly known as the West African olive, is a plant species belonging to the Annonaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Monanthotaxis littoralis include its ability to act as a diuretic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as urinary tract infections and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in developing new medicines.
